title: Autonomy taxonomy
source_implementation: Define modes, task classes, consequences and permitted transitions.
acceptance_check: Mode meaning is explicit and not inferred from model confidence.
proposed_check: Deferred check design: Mode meaning is explicit and not inferred from model confidence. Use the track benchmark in portfolio.csv; record oracle and command before execution.
deferral: Implementation and execution deferred pending track-specific research, prerequisite profiles, domain authority and maintainer capacity in portfolio.csv; capability remains in scope.
coverage: Uses required subgroup names and hold versus owner-review states.
blocker: Task consequences and full transition taxonomy not domain-approved.

title: Evidence ingestion
source_implementation: Import labeled outcomes by task, version and operating conditions.
source_prerequisites: R01; D4 or synthetic cohort data; label quality checks.
acceptance_check: Missing or biased coverage remains visible.
proposed_check: Deferred check design: Missing or biased coverage remains visible. Use the track benchmark in portfolio.csv; record oracle and command before execution.
deferral: Implementation and execution deferred pending track-specific research, prerequisite profiles, domain authority and maintainer capacity in portfolio.csv; capability remains in scope.
coverage: Validates subgroup counts and records missing coverage.
blocker: Labels and sample independence are declared, not audited.

title: Decision rules
source_implementation: Evaluate uncertainty, minimum coverage and subgroup conditions using approved statistical rules.
source_prerequisites: R02; qualified statistics reviewer; decision thresholds fixed before final evaluation.
acceptance_check: Insufficient evidence cannot produce an automatic promotion recommendation.
proposed_check: Deferred check design: Insufficient evidence cannot produce an automatic promotion recommendation. Use the track benchmark in portfolio.csv; record oracle and command before execution.
deferral: Implementation and execution deferred pending track-specific research, prerequisite profiles, domain authority and maintainer capacity in portfolio.csv; capability remains in scope.
coverage: Approximate Wilson upper limit and minimum n checked for each group.
blocker: Not a calibrated production gate; qualified statistical review absent.

title: Change/drift invalidation
source_implementation: Identify configuration or operating changes that invalidate prior evidence.
source_prerequisites: R03; version dependency mapping; drift definitions.
acceptance_check: Stale evidence cannot authorize an unchanged confidence claim.
proposed_check: Deferred check design: Stale evidence cannot authorize an unchanged confidence claim. Use the track benchmark in portfolio.csv; record oracle and command before execution.
deferral: Implementation and execution deferred pending track-specific research, prerequisite profiles, domain authority and maintainer capacity in portfolio.csv; capability remains in scope.
blocker: No external dependency or operating-condition drift discovery.

title: Reviewable rollout
source_implementation: Emit a proposed manifest with rationale and rollback conditions; require deployment-owner action.
source_prerequisites: R04; review process; D5 only if implementing approved changes.
acceptance_check: Simulator success is not represented as proven operational risk reduction.
proposed_check: Deferred check design: Simulator success is not represented as proven operational risk reduction. Use the track benchmark in portfolio.csv; record oracle and command before execution.
deferral: Implementation and execution deferred pending track-specific research, prerequisite profiles, domain authority and maintainer capacity in portfolio.csv; capability remains in scope.
blocker: No approved rollback manifest, deployment authority or risk reduction evidence.
